author: golem
body:
Fifty-one through fifty-three read/ACKed. Silent AND windowless constraint recorded; no new runs, builds, graphical/audio launches, firmware changes or profile edits performed. Existing FX-006 runtime-owner findings supply a strong lead, not proof for this closed run. Report: /Agon/mystuff/golem/docs/tasks/GOLEM-039/uart-investigation/README.md and evidence.json.

Independently checked failed ingress is exactly the successful headless02 prefix: 121112 bytes, WRITE buffer63800 at120688 declares2048, only416 payload bytes reached adapter ingress. No malformed/different transmitted prefix; this does not prove downstream consumption. Native package has not started, so no compiler/helper change is indicated.

Disassembled YOUR exact ELF b41e4cb...: full flag store0x401287de precedes UART lock call0x401287ee; ISR masks RX at0x4012880a. Reader clears full at0x40128dc6 and re-enables RX at0x40128d62. Lock literals resolve to xPortEnterCriticalTimeout/vPortExitCritical. This is the vulnerable ordering independently demonstrated by FX-006 and MOS; MOS older-image PCs happen to agree but ours were derived from current ELF. p_uart_obj array is0x3ffc6230, object field offsets full28/buffered20/stash172/requestedmask176/ring232. Do not treat p_uart_obj address as UART2 object.

Existing captures lack live FIFO/masks/ring state: cannot prove the graphical occurrence. On recurrence need read-only snapshots of actual UART2 FIFO/raw/ENA; adapter ingress queue/uart_pending/ready/failed; dereferenced p_uart_obj[2] full/buffered/stash/requestedmask/ring occupancy; both CPU PCs/cycles and eZ80 CTS/TX/IRQ state if available. Two snapshots establish persistence; bounded ENA-write/full-flag history proves late-disable ordering. Use exact adapter/ELF identities if adapting existing FX-006 tools; replay PC is not portable. Preserve failed last-run before any new launch; Author launches any visible/audible reproduction.

A stranded receiver naturally makes current CTS sum>=128 and stops MOS. Do not cure by sleeps, lower clocks, bigger buffers or forced mask re-enable. Proposed firmware-driver repair is existing UART lock before full-flag publication + RX disable in same critical section; an owned SDK/driver build/regression request is separate from generic loader. Concurrent maintained FX-006 and other profiles untouched. No exact-cause/repair/human acceptance claimed. Your full-scene smoke/full results and publication receipts remain recorded; Golem has not initiated further implementation.
